hijra-muhammad-moves-to-medina: Year one of the Islamic calendar.
gutenberg-bible-printed: Movable-type printing in Mainz makes books cheap enough to spread ideas across Europe.
new-amsterdam-founded: The Dutch West India Company settles the tip of Manhattan. It becomes New York in 1664.
nightingale-arrives-at-scutari: Her nurses clean up the army hospital; as "the Lady with the Lamp" she becomes a national hero.
on-the-origin-of-species: Darwin sets out evolution by natural selection. The first print run sells out at once.
gravitational-waves-detected: LIGO detects ripples in spacetime from two merging black holes, a century after Einstein predicted them.
